messages:
riley: Hey team, just joined — followed the onboarding email and placed the kubeconfigs into ~/.kube/onboard.yaml and set KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/onboard.yaml:~/.kube/config. `kubectl config get-contexts` shows contexts but when I try `kubectl get pods -n dev` I get "forbidden: User "system:anonymous" cannot". Any idea?

sam: Welcome! Usually that means the user entry isn't configured (no token or exec plugin). Run `kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/onboard.yaml config view --raw` and check users[].user.

riley: I ran it — users list has an entry name: riley@redwood but user: {} (empty). The file has clusters and contexts though.

devex-bot: Reminder: kubeconfigs from the portal should include either 'user.token' or 'user.exec' for SSO. If missing, request regen.

sam: I'll open an infra ticket to regenerate with exec plugin. @ops-bot can you create ONB-2044 for riley?

ops-bot: Ticket created: ONB-2044. Assigned to eng-infra. ETA 20m.

sam: Temp workaround: I can grant you a RoleBinding `onboard-riley-view` in namespace `dev` for 2 hours so you can list resources. Do you want that?

riley: Yes please, that'll help with the quick walkthrough.

sam: Done. Try `kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/onboard.yaml get pods -n dev` now.

riley: Works! Also noticed certificate errors earlier until I ran `kubectl --kubeconfig=~/.kube/onboard.yaml config view --raw` — the cluster has `certificate-authority: /etc/redwood/ca.pem`. Would you recommend embedding CA data instead?

sam: Yes — embedding `certificate-authority-data` avoids host-specific file path issues. I asked infra to include that in the regen. Also we'll add a note to the onboarding doc: "Verify user credentials and CA fields after extracting kubeconfigs."

riley: Thanks all — saved me a lot of time. Where to ask later for `edit` access?

sam: For edit-level, file a request in #eng-infra with duration & justification and tag me. View-level we can usually patch inline.

riley: Closing the loop — will update the checklist if anything else pops up. Appreciate the help! :smile:
